title: Holds Many Utensils, But Dominates Kitchen Countertop
text:
Holds Many Utensils, But Dominates Kitchen Countertop. This MONARCH ABODE HAND HAMMERED KITCHEN UTENSIL HOLDER CROCK (Large, Nickel) is very large indeed--about the size of a champagne bucket. The upside is that it holds a lot of kitchen utensils; the downside is that it dominates your kitchen countertop.

To my eye, the utensil holder is cheap looking. In the product page photo, the crock looks quite attractive because it appears to be smaller than it actually is. In reality, the decorative hand-hammered “dots” (each about the size of your little finger tip) don’t appear as decoration, but as big depressions that are arranged in uneven rows. The gray matte interior is unattractive.

I don’t think that this item is dishwasher safe. A trip through the dishwasher will probably ruin the exterior finish. My photo shows the utensil crock with a pineapple corer to give you an idea of the size.
